description: Repairs r-def-cat-txn/cat-xproc-catalog-visibility: A read B's new table, query and property seconds after B closed, from collections it held, so Refresh did not show them and staleness could not be separated from invisibility. Process A creates a new ACCDB with T, closes it, opens it shared and holds TableDefs, QueryDefs and Properties (Count read). Process B (shared, read/write) creates table T2 with a row, saves query Q9, appends Database property ProbeProp and closes. A then waits 7 s and reads the counts and Item lookups of T2, Q9 and ProbeProp as held; after Refresh of each collection; after DBEngine.Idle(dbRefreshCache); and through a second Database opened on the same file (counts, lookups and a snapshot of T2).
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
